I AMA Lifeguard at a Fitness Center. AMA!
Do you get into a lot of random sexual encounters, or has porn lied to me?
Oh no, it definitely happens. Been there and done that in college.

There has definitely been some flirting and stuff with girls I know from high-school! And then every so often we will get tourists from Australia who sun bathe topless. Then It's my job to go over and explain the pool's policy to her, and if she refuses there isn't anything I can do ;)!
I'm a guy so I'm just going to say 'maybe'?

When I was a teenager, someone left a piece of their scalp on the cement next to the ladder by the high dive. The life guard sat in one of those elevated seats right beside the ladder and the bloody hunk of hair and tissue. There is no way the lifeguards could have missed it, yet it remained there for several days.

My questions are the following:

  1. How do you think a hairy chunk of someone's head could have ended up on the pool deck?

  2. Is there a standard procedure for removing chunks of human flesh from pool areas?

  3. What is the nastiest thing you have ever dealt with as a lifeguard?

1. If it is in the southwest I would presume an Indian attack.

  2. Yes, a Bleach-Ammonia solvent works to destroy any bacteria or virus that may linger on the pool deck as well. Removing human flesh and other bodily items is standard procedure.

  3. A kid once threw up during swim lessons and my lead guard forced us to stay in the water and finish lessons before cleaning up the kids breakfast. The smell lingered the entire session and we were half way done with lessons so that kinda sucked... Also, I had to remove handfuls of dead beetles from some drainage pipes, the smell was awful and it took me around half an hour to acquire a giant bucket of beetles, some that happened to still be alive. Nothing too terrible as of yet!
What is a Fitness Center compared to say a Gym? Is it just the pool or is it more than that?
Basketball courts, racket ball court, ping-pong, indoor track, Olympic 50m swimming pool & indoor pool, food concessions. It is basically just a gym with benefits I suppose. 20$ for a month
